scope: Existing Stage1 forest encounter stones and all existing chests only; source2D project unchanged.
method: Reproducible native full-volume mesh construction. No new image/model generation, image painting, relighting or baked shadows.

materials.stone: Existing shared front-on generated limestone, 2.56m world tile / 8 courses; instance tint observes source flash.
materials.chest: Existing shared front-on generated timber, .65 UV scale (1.538m tile), and shared iron colour/roughness/metallic response selected by geometry vertex mask. No painted iron overlay.
materials.texel_density: 627px limestone:244.92px/m; timber:407.55px/m. No normal/roughness image maps invented.
materials.limitations: Reused generated albedos retain fine authored self-relief, not measured PBR scans.

chest_proportion_change: The old ~111.7-world-unit target sprite was replaced by a below-knee-height physical chest bounded by its existing 24px-radius cylinder; the old source card was much wider/taller than that inset physical collider. The original centre/ground source point, collider and consumed lifetime remain unchanged.

ownership.stone: Only the art instance IDs of the exact six EncounterStone owners; excludes only those old environment cards.
ownership.chest: Only current Chest.body_sprite IDs; breaking replaces this sprite identity. Affordances remove the previous fallback and retain fallback when no model is owned.
ownership.regions: Explicit forest scope plus source-local visibility; hidden adapter ancestors are ignored. Native roots hidden in cave and cleaned when owners leave the source world.
ownership.runtime: Read-only EncounterRuntime states/charges/recharge/living/can_summon, EncounterStone source tint/flash and Chest.dead. No visual timer, altered collision or extra rewards.

validation.headless: native_encounter_props PASS; actual source strike/open, capsule collider release, hinge-volume check, hidden/cave/return/deletion ownership.

gpu.interpretation: Actual coordinated captures were inspected separately; recording evidence is not automatic style approval.

validation.review_fixture: Explicit loot_review=1 in a fresh isolated browser profile only. Official create_slot binds a unique test session before original source state methods. Same source anchors and fixed120 camera; optional native-model rotation checks unseen faces, optional original-art cards provide same-world comparison.
